note: All five commands are read-only with respect to production. V0/V5 read file metadata and hashes; V1 hashes the frozen samples; V2 issues SELECT-only queries against the production catalog through a mode=ro URI; V3 writes only under the attempt's iso/ (copies + an attempt-owned sqlite); V4 copies the production config into iso/ and rebinds one line. No command executes a resolve, touches a provider, or starts/stops a worker.

commands.purpose: V0: before-state — three repo heads/porcelain, production catalog (bytes, mtime, -wal/-shm), the sha256 of every anchor file
V1: re-derive the three sample identities by hash (raw + sidecar + request) and compare against the frozen manifest constants; identity is never taken from a filename
commands.expected_business_result: all_match=true with all three samples true
commands.observed_business_result: all_match=true; CN/HK/US all true; request identity (market/fiscal_year/document_kind/company_query/as_of_date=2026-09-18/schema_version=1.1) matches for all three

commands.purpose: V2: read-only observation of the production catalog for the three frozen document ids (documents/sources/locations/artifacts/evidence_spans/document_entities) plus the multi-root same-bytes census and the roots table
commands.expected_business_result: catalog identity unchanged; per-sample row counts that decide the indexed vs unregistered cells
commands.observed_business_result: catalog_identity_unchanged=true; CN 1/1/3/2 rows, HK 0/0/0/0, US 0/0/0/0; 20 content hashes reachable from more than one root; 4 registered roots

commands.purpose: V3/V4: build the isolated root (copies in production layout) and an attempt-owned catalog with the three state labels, then copy the production config with exactly one line rebound
commands.expected_business_result: 3 raw + 3 sidecar copies hash-identical to their sources, sources still present, isolated catalog counts 1/1/1/1/1, exactly 1 changed config line, production config hash unchanged

commands.purpose: V5: post-observation integrity — re-hash the samples, sidecars, config and anchors, re-read the catalog identity and the three repos' porcelain
commands.observed_business_result: catalog identity unchanged; all 12 anchors unchanged; all three heads unchanged; product-only porcelain unchanged; slo_probe blob == HEAD

commands.purpose: V6: derive the frozen state matrix and the per-case state records from the evidence above (pure derivation, no production access)
commands.expected_business_result: bound/planned/blocked counts with not_applicable == 0 and every blocked cell naming a concrete reason
commands.observed_business_result: first pass: bound 10 / planned 14 / blocked 5 / not_applicable 0. After the r2 correction pass (F-I07A-01): bound 9 / planned 15 / blocked 5 / not_applicable 0; V1-V5 pass true, V6 generality cell blocked, V7 no-silent-NA true

commands.purpose: r2 correction pass (F-I07A-01 / F-I07A-02 / F-I07A-05): re-observe the roots table as SQL output, report the multi-root census UNTRUNCATED, and record the CN-uniqueness SQL
commands.expected_business_result: roots table as SQL (4 rows incl. future_lake), per-root location counts, CN location SQL, untruncated census totals; catalog identity unchanged
commands.observed_business_result: roots rows=4 (company_raw, dayu_portfolio, dropbox_stock, future_lake); locations per root 33092/3660/9853/1; CN locations=3 (two original_primary, observed_size 79925886 each); census totals 3440 content hashes / 3436 documents; catalog identity unchanged

commands.purpose: re-run the V5 integrity snapshot after the r2 correction pass so the no-production-mutation witness covers V7 as well
commands.observed_business_result: catalog identity unchanged; 12 anchors unchanged; three heads unchanged; product-only porcelain unchanged

expected_vs_raw_note: every command is expected 0 because every command is read-only or writes only inside the attempt directory. A non-zero code would have been reported as a raw finding, not folded into a summary.

superseded_first_pass_counts.why: config.legal_fifth_root moved bound -> planned after review finding F-I07A-01 / ruling J2
